value.rationale: The Coxeter graph is a canonical 28-vertex cubic distance-transitive hypohamiltonian graph. Its full chip-firing Jacobian, generator rank six, exponent 56 and seven-primary rank five are structurally finer than known spanning-tree count and useful exact benchmark invariants; the isolated computation is motivated by this canonical graph, not an arbitrary slice.
